messages:
marta_product: Quick sync — we need to lock the "model introspection" discovery API contract by EOW. Main knobs: streaming type, function/tool whitelist, structured-output formats, and token limits. Can we agree on a minimal surface that Dedicated/Private + Hosted will implement?

jordan_eng: +1. I can draft a minimal JSON shape. Important: make the streaming enum explicit (none|chunked|event) and indicate fallback priority. Backwards compatibility: if a field is missing, treat as conservative (feature off).

ana_api: for completeness add embedding metadata and reranking support flags. Customers also ask for per-model "max_context_tokens" and a per-request "user_token_budget" hint.

jordan_eng: draft proposal (quick sketch):
```json
{
  "model": "string",
  "capabilities": {
    "chat": true,
    "completions": true,
    "streaming": "chunked",
    "functions": ["http", "sql"],
    "structured_output": ["json_schema"],
    "max_tokens": 8192,
    "kv_cache": true
  },
  "embeddings": { "supported": true, "dims": 1536 },
  "reranking": true,
  "variants": ["fp16", "q4_k_mixed"]
}
```

tina_se: a couple of customer asks: 1) note whether streaming is server-push vs event-stream 2) expose a "rate_hint" for streaming (e.g., "avg_tokens_per_second") so clients can size buffer/UX. Also many enterprise customers want explicit KMS/TEK policy flags exposed (not the keys, just whether CMEK supported).

rachel_pm: Launch checklist suggestion: docs + example responses (incl. streaming snippets), SDK support (JS/Python), e2e within Dedicated, eval suite for structured-output regressions, and a migration note (old discovery -> new). Must have rollback/fallback behavior defined.

jordan_eng: + fallback note: discovery should include "compatibility_map" that lists model->compatible_variants and a "fallback_order" array. Runtime can then route automatically when preferred variant unavailable. Also add a "degradation_policy" field (e.g., degrade_to: "lower_latency"/"lower_cost").

ana_api: about token caps: recommend surface contain both "max_context_tokens" and "recommended_max_request_tokens". Example values differ between Hosted and Dedicated; we should allow fields to be overridden per-deployment but discovery response must expose the effective limits.

tina_se: customers asking about tool-level granularity — we should support a per-tool allowlist: e.g., "tools_supported": [{"name":"sql","modes":["readonly"]}]. That also helps SSO and audit DX when enabling features for orgs.

jordan_eng: small bikeshed: name the endpoint /v1/models/:model/introspect or /v1/models/:model/discovery? I lean toward /introspect to signal machine-readable contract.

marta_product: thanks — this is exactly the scope. Action items: @jordan_eng to drop a PR with canonical JSON schema, @ana_api to add embedding/rerank fields, @rachel_pm to author the launch checklist. Can @tina_se capture the top 3 enterprise asks as acceptance criteria? Aim: PR + checklist by Thu EOD.

deploy-bot: canary scheduled for friday 02:00 UTC for dependent infra changes.

rachel_pm: noted. I'll add a short migration note for partners that rely on the current discovery shape.

marta_product: awesome — if we can get the draft schema up today I can start doc samples and a short post for roadmap slack. :thumbsup:
